learning_outcomes.text: Acquiring knowledge, experience, and skills that promote faster integration of future graduates into industrial activity.
Deepening practical knowledge in technical disciplines, with applicability in the design and production of industrial products.
Practical realization of different scenarios encountered in industrial activity.
Identifying means and methods of measurement and control.

syllabus_topics: Methods for technical drawing, measurement, and control used in technological processes
Elements of preparation and elaboration of design documentation for machines, equipment, and mechanical installations
Concepts of design in Mechanical Engineering, based on the product life cycle
Elements of CAD modeling of mechanical systems

assessment_methods.method: Verification of knowledge acquired during the internship/practice

assessment_rules: To pass the course, a minimum of 50% knowledge acquisition is required, along with the elaboration of the practice notebook.
